title.zh: House Oversight Expands Prediction-Market Probe to Hyperliquid
title.en: House Oversight Expands Prediction-Market Probe to Hyperliquid

current_state.zh: House Oversight is expanding its prediction-market probe, with Chairman Comer demanding identity-verification and suspicious-trading records from Hyperliquid Labs, Crypto.com, and PredictIt owner Aristotle Exchange.
